sections.title: Ordering a *custom cake*
sections.intro: Custom orders need at least 48 hours’ notice. Because of the nature of our products, all sales are final.

items.title: Tell us about it
items.text: Your event date, theme, colors, flavors and any inspiration you have.

items.title: We confirm the details
items.text: Someone from Taste of Gold gets back to you to confirm the details and pricing.

items.text: Ready on the day, at 1306 Whiskey Road.

sections.title: Aiken’s *pop-up cakery*

image.alt: The pink front door at 1306 Whiskey Road, with Sweets and Welcome signs

body: Taste of Gold Cakery is Aiken’s local pop-up cakery and the home of Suga Momma, our gourmet cupcake vending machine.

Our cupcake menu changes with each Treat Day, so there’s always a new flavor to look out for. Follow us for the next Treat Day, the latest menu and Suga Momma restock updates. We’ll see you at 1306 Whiskey Road.
list: A new menu every Treat Day

items.q: How much notice do custom orders need?

items.a: The cupcake menu changes every Treat Day, from classic red velvet to Biscoff Nana Puddin’.

items.q: Can I return or exchange an order?
items.a: Because of the nature of our products, all sales are final: no refunds, exchanges or returns.
